escalationTrigger: user asked 'is this the best you can do?'

mission.stated: A top-down arena shooter built with Godot 4.3 and C# (.NET 8). Fight waves of enemies across 4 hero classes; environmental destruction escalates threat via the Collateral Karma system.
mission.actual: A horde / top-down arena shooter (Vampire Survivors / Brotato / Hades-like) with 4 heroes, 10 enemy types, Weibull wave-spawning curve, 2000-enemy cap, 5s breather between waves, boss every 300s, XP-driven level-up into a 20-perk upgrade menu, and Collateral Karma threat escalation.
mission.gap: No tutorial/onboarding, no difficulty selector, no perk transparency (17 of 20 perks are no-ops), no practice/sandbox mode, XP bar has no MaxValue.

codeQuality.finding: Clean style; pure logic extracted from Node wrappers per AGENTS.md pattern.

architecture.finding: EventBus decoupling, object pooling, SpatialHashGrid O(1), FlowFieldPathfinder on background thread.

testing.finding: 131 xUnit tests pass headlessly. Godot headless gate cannot run C# in this workspace (toolchain gap).

security.finding: No external services, no secrets, no network deps.

performance.finding: Object pooling, spatial hash grid, capped spawns/frame (20), 2000-enemy cap.

documentation.finding: AGENTS.md/README accurate; docs/ux-feedback-spec.md covers combat juice, not onboarding.

gameplay.finding: UpgradeMenu.ApplyPerk() implements only 3 of 20 perks; the other 17 are no-ops.

optimality.algorithm: Weibull wave curve appropriate; SpatialHashGrid O(1); FlowFieldPathfinder on background thread.
optimality.complexity: Linear spawning capped at 2000 enemies; 20 spawns/frame throttle. No obvious N+1 or quadratic loops.
optimality.resources: ObjectPoolManager pre-allocates 5000 projectiles + 10000 decals (zero runtime instantiation).
optimality.scalability: Holds at current load; 2000-enemy cap provides ceiling.

externalResearch.query: Hades God Mode difficulty design Greg Kasavin GDC interview
externalResearch.finding: God Mode = player damage resistance 20% start, +2%/death, caps 80%, toggleable anytime, doesn't block achievements/content. Difficulty settings 'may need to be proprietary to the game.'

externalResearch.query: Vampire Survivors onboarding first level-up XP wave timing
externalResearch.source: Vampire Survivors Wiki (community) / Android Police dev interview
externalResearch.finding: 5 XP to level 2 (first level-up ~30-60s); 3-4 level-up options (Galante's sweet spot); learn-by-doing, no tutorial level.

externalResearch.query: Brotato danger levels difficulty scaling enemy stats spawn
externalResearch.finding: Danger scales BOTH enemy HP/damage/speed AND spawn composition (new types, elites, hordes, bosses). Danger 3: +12% dmg/hp; Danger 5: +40%; Nightmare: +60% dmg/hp +10% speed.

externalResearch.query: perk upgrade menu UX forced choice 3 options synergies roguelite
externalResearch.source: Hades 2 Wiki / VS Wiki / Digital Trends Brotato / kokutech
externalResearch.finding: Icon + name + explicit effect line; 3 options default; forced choice (skip/reroll gated behind currency); synergies via prerequisite badges not spelled-out optimal builds.

recommendations.title: R3 - Perk Transparency + Practice/Sandbox Mode
recommendations.why: 17 of 20 perks are no-ops in UpgradeMenu.ApplyPerk() (silent bug); no safe place to experiment under permadeath.
recommendations.what: Implement all 20 perks with real effects; add PerkDescription() + synergy tags shown as icon+name+one-line effect per perk card (3 options, forced choice); add Sandbox mode (no waves/GameOver, spawn dummies, god mode, try all heroes/perks, reset stats).
recommendations.endpoint: MainMenu.OpenSandbox() -> scenes/maps/Sandbox.tscn + scripts/maps/Sandbox.cs { SpawnDummy(Vector2?), SetGodMode(bool), ApplyPerk(PerkType), ResetHero() }; scripts/ui/UpgradeMenu.cs { PerkDescription(PerkType), ApplyPerk() all 20 perks }
recommendations.interactiveControl: Sandbox toolbar: Spawn Dummy / Toggle God Mode / Apply Perk dropdown / Reset Hero; UpgradeMenu perk cards with icon+name+description+synergy badge
recommendations.payload: PerkMeta[(string Name, string Description, string SynergyTag)] array of 20 entries; DifficultySettings struct (R2) reused by Sandbox god-mode resistance
recommendations.gate: ApplyPerk all-20-perks effect tests (headless xUnit); PerkDescription pure test (headless xUnit)
recommendations.sources: [T2] Android Police VS interview; [T3] VS Wiki Level up/Powerup; [T2] Digital Trends Brotato; [T3] Hades 2 Wiki Boons; [T3] kokutech Hades design

recommendations.title: R1 - Guided 'First Wave' Onboarding Mode
recommendations.why: New players receive no instruction; Wave 1 spawns mixed enemies at full speed; no GameState.Tutorial.
recommendations.what: Start directly in Wave 1 (no tutorial level - Hades/Vs philosophy); Wave 1 is soft (1-3 slow Drones one at a time); teach 3 verbs (move/dodge, attack, collect XP) in first 60s; auto-pause at first level-up (~5 XP); on-screen control prompts; 3-perk forced-choice UpgradeMenu.
recommendations.endpoint: MainMenu.StartTutorial() -> PendingTutorial flag -> GameManager.StartTutorial() -> GameState.Tutorial; scripts/ui/Tutorial.cs { enum Step{Move,Attack,Dodge,Ability,LevelUp,Done}, SpawnNextDrone(), ShowPrompt(Step), MarkStepDone(Step) }; scenes/ui/Tutorial.tscn
recommendations.interactiveControl: Center-screen gold prompt label (font_size 30, outline); progress dots 'Step X of 5'; forced-choice perk modal on first level-up
recommendations.gate: New GameState.Tutorial; tutorial-complete flag unlocks Normal mode in save data
recommendations.sources: [T1] GDC/Hades Kasavin interview; [T2] Android Police VS interview; [T2] Superjump Brotato; [T3] VS Wiki Level up

recommendations.title: R2 - Difficulty Selector (Easy / Normal / Hard)
recommendations.why: Single fixed Weibull + karma + mutator curve punishes novices; destroying environment raises threat.
recommendations.what: Difficulty enum in GameManagerState persisted to save; two orthogonal levers: spawn/density curve (Weibull multiplier) AND per-enemy stats (HP/damage) + threat interval + mutator scale + XP multiplier + breather seconds; optional Hades-style player damage-resistance toggle (20%->80% cap) that doesn't block progression.
recommendations.endpoint: GameManagerState.SetDifficulty(Difficulty) + GetSettings(Difficulty) -> DifficultySettings{EnemyCountMultiplier, EnemyHealthMultiplier, EnemyDamageMultiplier, ThreatInterval, MutatorScale, XpMultiplier, BreatherSeconds, PlayerDamageResistance}; WaveManager.BeginNextWave() reads GameManager.Instance.DifficultySettings; EnemyMutatorSystem.ApplyMutators(enemy, threatLevel, mutatorScale)
recommendations.interactiveControl: MainMenu difficulty buttons Easy/Normal/Hard with visual highlight on selected; optional God Mode resistance toggle
recommendations.payload: DifficultySettings { float EnemyCountMultiplier, EnemyHealthMultiplier, EnemyDamageMultiplier; int ThreatInterval; float MutatorScale, XpMultiplier, BreatherSeconds, PlayerDamageResistance }
recommendations.gate: GetSettings() pure -> headless xUnit; WaveFormulas.CalculateWaveEnemyCount(wave, active, multiplier) headless xUnit
recommendations.sources: [T2] Inverse Hades God Mode interview; [T2] Access-Ability Hades analysis; [T3-4] Brotato Wiki Danger Levels; [T4] VS Nexus curse
